description: This is a Java test class for the ProviderValidator in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing various validation scenarios for Provider entities.

classes.name: ProviderValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ProviderValidator, testing validation logic for Provider objects in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case.

methods.name: validate_shouldBeValidIfIdentifierIsNotSet
methods.description: Test that validation passes if the provider's identifier is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldBeValidIfIdentifierIsSet
methods.description: Test that validation passes if the provider's identifier is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldBeInvalidIfProviderIsRetiredAndTheRetiredReasonIsNotMentioned
methods.description: Test that validation fails if a retired provider lacks a retire reason.

methods.name: validate_shouldBeInvalidIfPersonIsNotSet
methods.description: Test that validation fails if the provider has no associated person.

methods.name: validate_shouldBeValidIfOnlyPersonIsSet
methods.description: Test that validation passes if only the person is assigned to the provider.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAProviderIfItHasFewerThanMinOccursOfAnAttribute
methods.description: Test that validation rejects a provider if an attribute's minimum occurrence is not met.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAProviderIfItHasMoreThanMaxOccursOfAnAttribute
methods.description: Test that validation rejects a provider if an attribute's maximum occurrence is exceeded.

methods.name: makeAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to create ProviderAttribute instances for tests.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptDuplicateIdentifierIfTheExistingProviderIsNotRetired
methods.description: Test that duplicate identifiers are accepted if the existing provider is not retired.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptDuplicateIdentifierIfTheExistingProviderIsRetired
methods.description: Test that duplicate identifiers are accepted if the existing provider is retired.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptADuplicateIdentifierForANewProviderWhichIsNotRetired
methods.description: Test that a new non-retired provider can have a duplicate identifier.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptADuplicateIdentifierForANewProviderWhichIsRetired
methods.description: Test that a new retired provider can have a duplicate identifier.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Test that validation passes when field lengths are within limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Test that validation fails when fields have excessive length.
